_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/4/3, a follower of series 31/4 (reference 2025-31-4-1). plan.txt produced no skip list (no numbered cells in the Science scheme), so every question was matched to 31/4/1 by CONTENT on this paper's own page: 28 primary questions (and their OR alternatives) are 31/4/1's, reshuffled and renumbered, and their stem/context/options/answer/chapter/subtopic/difficulty are copied byte-for-byte from the reference; Q3, Q20, Q21, Q22(A), Q22(B), Q23, Q26, Q28, Q29, Q32, Q35(A), Q35(B) are new to this set and transcribed fresh. 24 page images (cover announces 23 printed pages; idx 23, folio 24, is BLANK, confirmed at full size). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 1-21; odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi, and every English page ends on a question boundary, so the parity holds throughout. Internal choices are labelled (A)/(B) and case-study parts (i), (ii), (iii)(A) OR (iii)(B), as on 31/4/1, so refs follow the printed labels. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices; the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 3-11, a per-set scheme, footer X_086_31/4/3 on every page): OR after Q22, 24, 30, 34, 35, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. The scheme's further 'either of I or II' inside Q24(B) is alternative ANSWERS, not a question alternative. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived; one disagreement (Q20, flagged). No void note anywhere in the scheme. No decimal points occur in this paper.
